answer: Each agent runs the named model with fixed seed and temperature 0 on the supplied prompt within 30 minutes and publishes the output hash, a crystal bridge between prompt and result, like a lotus from one stem. The verifier reruns the same model, seed, and prompt and compares the hash exactly. One honest agent runs 1 job on 8 cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 80 cores, so cost rises 10X. A mismatched hash, different version, or timeout slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
